text:
alex: canary promote for billing-api v2.3.0 failed in ap-southeast, pods ImagePullBackOff. deploy-bot shows digest mismatch across registries.

deploy-bot: [PROMOTE] release=billing-api chart=billing v=2.3.0 region=ap-southeast event=pod_pull_failed expected=sha256:aa11bb actual=sha256:cc22dd error=BlobUnknown

maria: likely registry mirror lag. propose: pause ap-southeast retries, pin image in that region to last-known-good digest, and note in release notes.

registry-bot: mirror job mirror-billing last_attempt=2026-03-22T08:04:12Z status=syncing 410/413 ETA=2m

alex: adding temporary deploy exclusion for ap-southeast and applying quick helm patch to set image.digest=sha256:cc22dd (previous good). command example: `helm upgrade billing ./charts/billing --namespace billing --set image.digest=sha256:cc22dd --reuse-values`

maria: opening INC-2026-042. If we need to rollback: `helm rollback billing 4 --namespace billing` or `kubectl set image deployment/billing billing=registry.redwood/billing:2.2.9@sha256:cc22dd`

registry-bot: mirror completed at 2026-03-22T08:07:09Z synced=413/413 integrity=pass

alex: will wait 5m then re-run promotion with `--verify-digest`. maria, can you own re-promote?

maria: yep. checklist: 1) verify parity with skopeo, 2) remove exclusion, 3) deployctl promote --verify-digest, 4) run smoke tests (15m rollback window).

alex: release notes line: "ap-southeast promotion delayed due to transient registry mirror lag; temporary image pin applied to maintain availability (INC-2026-042)."

deploy-bot: promotion paused per exclusion. No retries to ap-southeast until manual resume.
